prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as their tests either lack a second trial or disagree on effect.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
Predictions have mostly been too high compared to noise-corrected measurements, though round 7 was underestimated.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: -0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: -0.4% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- finish, redesign: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, redesign: -0.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -6.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] sign_in_post_adoption_reorder: Reorder sign-in screen to appear after pet selection and adoption certificate steps, right before waiting. (why: Sign-in loses 27.1% of users before they experience pet adoption. Deferring authentication until after adoption builds user commitment.)
1: [adoption, redesign] pick_friend_carousel_redesign: Redesign pick_friend screen into a full visual carousel layout with animated preview cards and sound effects. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate at 60.9% and long completion time (89s median). A carousel layout simplifies choosing a companion.)
2: [home, new_screen] waiting_tips_interstitial_screen: Insert a new interactive onboarding screen 'new_waiting_tips' before the waiting screen with care tips while generation completes. (why: The waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, leading to drop-offs. Setting up expectations with dedicated tips keeps users engaged.)
3: [choose_path, new_flow] story_interactive_preview_flow: Add a new interactive intro story screen 'new_story_intro' before choose_path to showcase pet animations. (why: 23.8% of users leave at choose_path before experiencing pet interactions. A dynamic story preview boosts motivation.)
4: [choose_path, copy] choose_path_clarity_copy: Update choose_path headline and hint to emphasize fast setup and clear choice paths. (why: Choose path has a mean duration of 514s, indicating confusion or hesitation during initial mode selection.)
5: [sign_in, hint] sign_in_account_recovery_hint: Add a visual persistent storage hint on the sign_in screen reminding users to use the same account to retain pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again with a different account.)
6: [home, wait_info] waiting_progress_time_estimate: Enable live progress bar, time estimate display, and periodic tip carousel on the waiting screen. (why: Users spend a median 201s (mean 2336s) on the waiting screen, and display stalls prompt support tickets.)
7: [adoption, notification] upload_photos_quality_guide_notice: Add photo quality requirements notice badge and hint to the upload_photos screen. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation fails or results look distorted due to poor photo inputs.)
8: [finish, incentive] home_intro_completion_badge_incentive: Add an onboarding completion reward badge component on the home_intro screen. (why: Only 64.8% of users reach finish step completion; visual milestone badges incentivize final click-through.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in previously showed negative lift (-6.6%) and lacks strong evidence of success.
Adoption has high drop-off (39.1%), but major UI redesigns have unproven confidence and high implementation cost.
Adding new screens historically yields weak or negative results (-0.4% baseline) with heavy build cost.
New flow changes have shown no positive effect (-0.7%) across past onboarding tests.
Copy changes are low risk and quick to deploy via configuration.
Strongly supported by 8 support tickets and high drop-off; cheap UI/hint change.
Addresses extreme delay times and support tickets regarding perceived stalls.
Directly tackles 3 support tickets about generation failures with low configuration cost.
Targets 35.2% finish drop-off using a visual reward incentive component.
